template.title: The Forest Treasure Hunt
template.summary: A curious child collects nature treasures, searches for a special item, and learns that sometimes the unexpected can be the best addition to a collection.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] looked at the [[slot_collection_type]] in their [[slot_container]] and saw one empty spot.
They decided to find the missing piece, a [[slot_rare_feature]] one that would finish the set.
Outside, [[slot_child]] walked along the forest path, looking for a round white rock or a red pointy leaf.
They found a shiny leaf that was not the [[slot_rare_feature]] but it glittered in the sunlight.
On a tree stump, [[slot_child]] lines up ten smooth stones in a perfect circle, feeling proud.
The shiny leaf caught their eye, and they thought maybe it could be the new treasure.
They added the leaf to the collection, and the empty spot was now filled with something special.
The forest seemed brighter, and [[slot_child]] felt happy that the collection was complete.
They went back home, ready to show their friends the new addition.
And they knew that sometimes the best discoveries come when you look for something else.
